In 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment and data centers.
The net proceeds received by the company were $20.5 billion which will be used for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures to scale AI infrastructure and global compute.
The company intends to pay quarterly cash dividends in the future, subject to review and approval by the company’s Board of Directors in its sole discretion.
In certain instances, the amount of our contractual obligations may change based on the expected timing of order fulfillment from our suppliers.
Upon closing, we expect to receive $1.5 billion in cash, a $2.0 billion note receivable, and a 49.99% equity interest.
The remaining interest is expected to be accounted for as an unconsolidated VIE under the equity method of accounting, as we will no longer be the primary beneficiary.
